stories.title: Mikario Trading Baby Gym Recalled — Suffocation Hazard, Sold on TikTok Shop
stories.angle: CPSC recalls Mikario Trading 5-in-1 Convertible Baby Gyms — sold exclusively on TikTok Shop from May through October 2025 for about $50. The convertible mat can function as a tummy-time pillow, but the floor mat can obstruct an infant's breathing, violating the mandatory safety standard for infant support cushions. The pink units are Item No. CBPBG-PIN. Action: stop use immediately, destroy (cut mat in half), photograph the destruction, and contact Mikario Trading at mikariorecall@gmail.com or 209-232-8655 (Mon–Fri, 7 a.m.–1 p.m. ET) for a full refund. TikTok Shop angle is noteworthy — parents who shop via social commerce may not realize products there carry CPSC recall risk.

stories.title: D20 Enters Fall With New Board President — Payne Assumes Role After Shandy Moves Out of State
stories.angle: Academy School District 20 began the 2026-27 school year with leadership changes on its board of education. Board President Amy Shandy resigned in August after her family relocated out of Colorado for her husband's job. Her last board meeting was September 3, 2026. Vice President Susan Payne assumed the president role. The change follows a turbulent year that also included the board voting to part ways with the district superintendent in May 2026. D20 families are starting the school year under both a new board president and an interim leadership structure in the superintendent's office.

stories.title: Venetucci Farm Marks 90th Anniversary With Expanded Pumpkin Fest — Opens Oct 1
stories.angle: Venetucci Farm is celebrating its 90th anniversary with an expanded Pumpkin Fest season running every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday from October 1 through October 29. Admission is $5 per person; children 6 and under are free. Pumpkins are $10 any size. The farm at 5210 S. US-85-87 in Colorado Springs features a pumpkin patch, hayrides, scarecrow trail, games, concessions, and fall photo areas. Saturday and Sunday also include a craft fair in the barn and farm animals. Three themed weekends: Oct 10-11 (Great Pumpkin Weekend), Oct 17-18 (Scarecrows and Flannel), Oct 30-31 (Costume Party and Pup-Kin Fest with trick-or-treating for kids and dogs).

stories.title: AAP Updates Flu Vaccine Guidance — Some Kids Need Two Doses This Season
stories.angle: The American Academy of Pediatrics has released its 2026-27 influenza prevention and treatment recommendations. Key change for parents: children ages 6 months through 8 years who are receiving the flu vaccine for the first time, who received only one dose ever before July 1, 2026, or whose vaccination history is unknown, need two doses this season at least four weeks apart. Both doses should ideally be completed by the end of October. The two doses don't need to be the same brand or formulation. All 2026-27 flu vaccines in the U.S. are trivalent with updated compositions. This is separate from the AAP COVID vaccine guidance covered earlier this week.

article.headline: AAP 2026-27 Flu Vaccine Guide: Which Kids Need Two Doses This Season

research.facts:
AAP 2026-27 Flu Vaccine Guidance
**Two-dose requirement:**
- Who needs 2 doses: children ages 6 months–8 years who (a) are getting flu vaccine for the first time, OR (b) received only 1 dose ever before July 1, 2026, OR (c) vaccination history unknown
- Timing: at least 4 weeks apart
- Ideal completion: by end of October
- Same brand/formulation NOT required for both doses
**Vaccine formulation:**
- All 2026-27 US flu vaccines: trivalent, updated compositions
- No preference between egg-based, cell culture-based, recombinant, or LAIV formulations
**This is distinct from:** AAP COVID vaccine guidance covered Sep 25 (that was about COVID-19 VFC delays)
**Confidence:** HIGH on two-dose requirements, timing, formulation (healthychildren.org, contemporarypediatrics.com — AAP official sources)
